reason: No. The context loss switching between agents is real, but my first reaction to any new vendor is that I don't trust them with my code and session data. I read GitHub issues and Reddit before installing anything, and as a solo freelancer on $81k a year I'd rather keep my dev environment closed to a vendor I haven't seen vetted in public for months. $30 a month isn't the blocker; the trust is.
objection: I don't trust a new vendor with my code and session data — I'd want to see it debated on GitHub and Reddit for months before installing a daemon that owns every shared subsystem on my machine.
would_change_my_mind: An open-source daemon proven not to phone home, publicly vetted for months on GitHub and Reddit with no data-leak incidents.
